gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathology proven diagnosis of IDH-wildtype glioblastoma with unmethylated MGMT promoter confirmed by central pathology review.

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase III trial compares temporally-modulated pulsed radiation therapy versus standard radiation therapy in treating patients with newly diagnosed, IDH wildtype, MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma.
Patients also receive temozolomide PO QD on days 1-21 or 1-42.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Temporally-Modulated Pulsed Radiation Therapy Versus Standard Radiation Therapy for the Treatment of Newly Diagnosed, IDH Wildtype, MGMT-Unmethylated Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Patients also receive temozolomide PO QD on days 1-21 or 1-42.

source_quote.quote: Pathology proven diagnosis of IDH-wildtype glioblastoma with unmethylated MGMT promoter confirmed by central pathology review.
IDH mutation testing by at least one method (such as immunohistochemistry for IDH1 R132H) must be performed as part of standard of care and no mutation must be found (i.e. IDH-wildtype).

coder_notes: Investigational question is radiotherapy fractionation (TMPRT vs standard RT); temozolomide identical in both arms, so soc_backbone. No pharmacological candidate. IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic requirement; MGMT unmethylated is an entry requirement but not candidate-matched. Registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm provides the control.
